q1_issues.issue: AccordingTo's first argument must be the SEALED proposition — (AccordingTo (And ...) <source>) — but the parse passes the bare event symbol sk_drop_1, so nothing is sealed and the atom records only that the drop event stands in some relation to the research.

Every atom of the attributed proposition (the drop event and its tense/interval, both download events, both group witnesses, both cardinalities) is asserted at top level, violating the AccordingTo rule that only the attribution is asserted and no predication of P reaches top level.

The scalar-change figures are unencoded: "dropped from 14.5 million ... to 10.4 million" licenses MeasureFrom/MeasureTo on the drop event, and the drop event also has no Theme for its scalar-change subject ("the number of people downloading music").

q2_gaps: a count-denoting NP as the scalar-change subject ("the number of people downloading music dropped"): the scale-from-the-subject rule covers a dimension noun ("the temperature fell"), but nothing licenses tying the changing number to the group whose members it counts

a time attached to each endpoint of a scalar change ("from 14.5 million IN APRIL to 10.4 million IN JUNE"): MeasureFrom/MeasureTo have only scale/magnitude/unit slots and no time slot, so the per-endpoint dates cannot ride the values
notes: The source NP is handled well: the name-internal kind word licenses (Member the_npd_group group), market_research decomposes with its noun modifier unexposed, and entity-attached From carries "from The NPD Group". Start/End with Month terms is a plausible record of the April-June span, but it leaves the two stated values with no scalar-change carrier.
